title: Robot behind your shoulder
description: The kit robot lands behind your measured shoulder on the side with more room, its lower half hidden by you (person matte in front), its eyes on your face. It moves with your shoulder every frame.

props.hand: left | right: which shoulder (default: the side with more room)

source.note: uses the person matte (drawn behind you, you stay in front) and the body detector through meta "rig"
